stories.title: Around-the-clock search continues to reach victims of the 7.4 earthquake in Colombia
stories.summary: Search efforts continue though hopes are fading as teams dig for survivors from the 7.4 magnitude earthquake that killed more than 250 people.

stories.title: U.S. ambassador slams Israeli settlers besieging home of Palestinian-American
stories.summary: U.S. ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee called settlers besieging a West Bank home of an American-Palestinian family "terrorists."

stories.title: Could the National Guard play a role in the Midterms?
stories.summary: The National Guard's presence has become routine in D.C., but there's nothing routine about questions over the role the troops could play in the upcoming midterms.

stories.title: Europe swelters through its fifth heatwave of the summer
stories.summary: Europe is sweltering through its fifth heatwave this summer. It has already lasted longer than a deadly heat wave that killed thousands across Europe in 2003.

stories.title: World's youngest museum curator, 11, was led by a love of fossils
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Anderson Taylor, who has become the Guinness World Record holder for youngest male museum curator. He opened a natural history museum at age 9.

stories.title: A summer canoe trip through New York's north woods to wild sand beaches
stories.summary: NPR's Brian Mann paddled the Ausable River in northern New York on a summer day to swim on wild sand beaches that stretch along Lake Champlain's shore.
